_comment: The ally speed AURA (plan-effect-types.md C4 / D8+D9, design row content-auras.md:37): a field that carries everyone around you and never you. First content on the new `speed_aura` effect type - the same SpeedParams payload Swift's `speed_burst` carries, delivered as a field instead of as a cast, which is the whole of D8's extend-don't-add ruling. ⚑ THE CASTER IS EXCLUDED BY CONSTRUCTION (D9): `targetsSelf` is not even a legal key on this type, so the caster is never in its own in-range set. That asymmetry IS the skill - you run the field, you do not ride it, and the risk of being the slowest thing on the screen is what you are paying for the party's escape. ⚑ UNCAPPED on purpose (no `selector`, no `maxTargets`): the design row says all allies in radius, and a retreat tool that carries only the nearest one ally would be a different and much smaller skill. Levelling therefore buys DEPTH here (a faster factor) where Sanctuary/Aegis had to buy breadth - their factor 0 could not deepen, this one can. ⚑ NO `buffLifetimeMatchesInterval`: that lever is resist_aura-only by D7, and deliberately so. It exists because a permanent grant of immunity is worth any price and had to be billed per cycle; a haste field is priced honestly by the ordinary rule (a fresh buff is work and is charged, a refresh is free), so you pay for every ally who walks in and nothing for holding the ones already with you. The other price is the one the loadout charges: exactly one active aura is on at a time, so running this is running no damage aura. ⚑ No new pip: the buff lights the EXISTING green speed pip on every carried ally, because the pip is chosen by the buff PAYLOAD rather than by the effect type (D10 - this plan does no visibility work). The ring is new and green, the same green, by PO ruling 2026-08-17. All values [PLACEHOLDER]: radius 2.5 (wide for an aura, and the reach IS the skill - it has to cover a fleeing group), tickInterval 30 = 1 s as the re-application cadence rather than a hit cadence, speedFactor 1.3 +0.05/L (1.3 -> 1.5 at L5, deliberately under Swift's 1.5 -> 1.7 because this reaches a whole party and costs no cooldown), cost 0.03 +0.004/L as an ENTRY price on the Slow precedent (0.018) rather than a sustain rate, marked up for the stronger effect. Obtainable in dev via the SKILL FlyYouFools cheat; no unlock source yet (the FireVulnerability precedent), real placement comes with the content pass.
